_comment: monmove.c postmov() (1660-1681) and mon.c mpickstuff() (1857): a Valkyrie level-teleports into a general store and creates a peaceful rock mole, then rests. The mole wanders the shop and meatmetal() eats a wand that was the only object on its square. postmov() made its OBJ_AT() test before eating, so it still calls mpickstuff(), whose shop test draws rn2(25) on the now empty square. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
